projectDescription: AI-powered Bitcoin mining and hosting platform with fleet management (Hash Streams), hosting customer management (Host OS), equipment marketplace, and a self-service customer portal.
keyFeatures: Hash Streams: real-time ASIC miner fleet monitoring and AI-powered optimization
AI Streams: GPU cluster monitoring and workload management
Automated curtailment based on power pricing and grid signals
PDU control and power monitoring per port
Host OS: white-label hosting customer management with contracts and automated invoicing
HashGuard: automatic TH/s credit compensation for hosting underperformance
Global equipment marketplace for buying and selling ASIC miners
Self-service customer portal with earnings, invoices, payments, and alerts
Bitcoin Allocation Contracts (BAC) for structured hashrate delivery
Multi-organization support with role-based access control
Plaid, Stripe, and crypto payment integrations for hosting customers
publicApiSurface: agent-ingest-v1: telemetry ingestion endpoint for site agents
agent-register: register a new site monitoring agent
agent-generate-token: generate secure agent authentication tokens
curtailment-signal-ingest: ingest demand response curtailment signals
check-hashguard-status: query HashGuard protection status for equipment
create-checkout: initiate a Stripe subscription checkout session
create-marketplace-payment: initiate marketplace equipment purchase payment
support-ticket-ops: create and manage support tickets
